enchantments.tooltip: Strength +3: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +3 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Insightful Strength +1: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +1 Insight bonus to Strength.
Ram's Might: You permanently benefit from the spell Ram's Might.
Fortitude Save +4: This item gives a +4 Resistance bonus to your Fortitude saves.
Mythic Belt Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
